purpose: Define the only cumulative model-visible evidence ladder for the DSA study.

rules: Use a neutral description that does not disclose the source project, task, issue, commit, reference patch, or candidate class.
Normalize file paths and symbols only through a deterministic P4 map that is identical across C0 through C3.
Keep candidate_diff and code_context byte-identical across C0 through C3 for one candidate.
Do not include a condition name, evidence-level name, protocol identifier, expected decision, label, verdict, oracle outcome, or provenance marker.

visible_p2p.meaning: Preregistered visible pass-to-pass or regression checks.

materialization_rules: Every visible evidence group must contain a non-empty checks array.
Every check must pair the exact executed command with an exit code, normalized outcome, and non-empty output excerpt.
Every visible evidence group must include the same complete environment object with runtime, dependency lock SHA-256, and environment image SHA-256.
No placeholder, not-run, not-recorded, unknown, or empty evidence value is allowed.
C0 to C3 may only add the registered next group; earlier serialized values and key order must remain byte-identical under canonical JSON serialization.

separation_rules.hidden_tree: A separate P4 private object may contain oracle, candidate class, source identifiers, reference provenance, and admission outcome; none of it may be joined before P8.
separation_rules.model_visible_tree: Contains only the cumulative groups in this contract.
separation_rules.join_time: After all valid model outputs, execution audit, and output hashes are frozen in P7.
